tasks.label: ProductPromo-db
tasks.command: & 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\pg_ctl.exe' -D 'C:\Users\andre\PostgresData\product_promo' status 2>$null; if (-not $?) { & 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\pg_ctl.exe' -D 'C:\Users\andre\PostgresData\product_promo' -l 'C:\Users\andre\PostgresData\product_promo.log' -w -t 60 start }; & 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\pg_isready.exe' -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5435

tasks.label: ProductPromo-backend
tasks.command: $pgr='C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\pg_isready.exe'; for ($i=0; $i -lt 90; $i++) { & $pgr -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5435 -q 2>$null; if ($?) { break }; Write-Host "waiting for postgres on 5435... ($i)"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; & $pgr -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5435; if (-not $?) { Write-Host 'Postgres never came up - start the ProductPromo-db task first.' -ForegroundColor Red } else { poetry run uvicorn backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8004 --reload }
